title: Legal pages
summary: Legal notice, privacy, terms of use and terms of sale. Footer only. Never in the shop info menu. This plugin mounts the React pages.

blocks.title: Page plugin
blocks.text: package.json tuucho.kind page, route /legal. This plugin mounts /legal, /privacy, /terms and /sales-terms. No nav.key: legal documents stay in the footer only, never the shop info menu. Disable and the plugin drops out of the sitemap listing; footer links stay so the documents remain reachable.

items.description: /legal (legal notice). /privacy, /terms and /sales-terms are the other documents in this plugin's copy pack.
While Sitemap pages is on, the kernel lists this route on seo.sitemap.entries. Extra paths that are not this route must register the filter yourself (Guides does /pose and /capsules).
